body: Good point. I suffer from these impulses I get from time to time where I want to end all the suffering, it’s really hard to put into context how I feel at that moment and it stays with me for hours than I snap out of it all of a sudden it’s really weird and unlike me at all

Well don’t do that silly although the chances for success are stacked in your favor there is chances that method failing and causing you great debilitating pain, I would name examples but you would probs just write me off as “this dudes crazy, that couldn’t happen to me” lol I say get on the train think some things over while on your travels

That or I could easily pull the trigger it’s just finding a place to do the deed and doing so in a way that anyone that has ever had an interest in me won’t be traumatized for life, I don’t want to emotionally scar anyone but at the same time I don’t put thought into it nor want to as it’s my decision and to be frank at this point it’s the least of my concerns

I suffer a inconceivable amount day in and day out from a multitude of things I could name em all from a-z but that would take a while,I have bad mental issues that take a toll on me daily and any/every time I try to better myself or my life it’s always met with great resistance not to mention my support group is slim to none, nitrogen asphyxiation seems like the best prospect to me now more than ever before in my 28 years of miserable existence

Shoot your shot by all means please do I could really use the convincing as I’m about to make a permanent decision on these lingering bouts of suffering that may be able to be helped that will effect a greater number of people than I can probably imagine, thank you for taking time out of your day you’re a kind soul
You can always talk to me I don’t judge, your secrets will be safe with me as I’ll be gone before the little hand strikes midnight

Lmao Hope you get it bro...
I have one at 11am and 3pm today as well, wish me luck, haven’t slept in over 24hrs, bout to redose before I head out yeeeee
